title: Record type definition, version 1
description: Defines one kind of record as data: its fields, its stages, and the moves between stages that are allowed. Rules that compare one part of the document with another (for example that `initial` is one of `stages`) cannot be written in JSON Schema; they are listed in schemas/README.md and checked separately.

type.description: The name of the record type, for example `invoice`.

version.description: The version of this definition. A later version of the same type has a higher number.

fields.description: The fields a record of this type can hold, by field name.

stages.description: Every stage a record of this type can be in.

initial.description: The stage a new record starts in. Must be one of `stages`.

transitions.description: The allowed moves between stages. A move that is not listed here is refused.

terminal.description: Stages a record never leaves. Each must be one of `stages`.

kind.description: What kind of value the field holds.

required.description: When true, every record of this type must have a value for the field.

unique.description: When true, no two records of this type may hold the same value. Allowed only for kinds whose values have one written form: string, int, date, datetime and ref.

currency.description: For kind `money`: the three-letter currency code of the amount.

values.description: For kind `enum`: the values the field may take.

type.description: For kind `ref`: the record type the field points to.

from.description: The stage the move starts from, or a list of stages that can all make this move.

to.description: The stage the move ends in.

requires.description: Fields that must have a value before the move is allowed.
